rubric: Frame and assumptions stated (days, eaters, diet, time); one line per meal with the dish, cooking time and leftovers noted.
Ingredients reused on purpose across days; bases and proteins varied; dishes doable in the time given.
Diet rules kept as hard rules (halal, no pork, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, allergies) with label-check notes where needed.
Shopping list grouped by shop area with quantities for the number of eaters; items the user has are left out.
2 or 3 prep tips; no invented prices; medical diets defer to the doctor or dietitian.
